CAD lets you see and size the parts before you cut them.

::: {.phone-step-strip}
::: {.phone-mini-step}
**1. Sketch**<br>
Draw the flat shape.
:::
::: {.phone-mini-step}
**2. Size**<br>
Add the needed dimensions.
:::
::: {.phone-mini-step}
**3. Extrude**<br>
Give the part its thickness.
:::
::: {.phone-mini-step}
**4. Assemble**<br>
Join the parts on screen.
:::
::: {.phone-mini-step}
**5. Draw**<br>
Show the views and sizes.
:::
:::

## Before you build

- Check that the parts fit on a 12 x 12 inch sheet.
- Check the slot against the real material thickness.
- Make an assembly.
- Make a drawing with the needed sizes.
- [Submit the CAD work](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1NgAOEpUvRkkanlb8MvY5porLpp18FNvFNbXxHZ6il-4/edit?tab=t.0).

Next: [see the tools and machines](../hand-tools/tools-machines.qmd).
